name: California Public School
definition: A California school record identified by the 14-digit CDSCode, carrying identity, location, type, administration and operational attributes.
scope: california_schools sub-database; one row per school per CDSCode

name: School District
definition: Administrative district that operates one or more schools; district names repeat across counties.

name: School Communication Address
definition: Physical or mailing address of a school composed of street, city, state and ZIP code.
scope: california_schools; address questions require all four components

name: School Administrator Contact
definition: Named administrator (principal) of a school with first name, last name and e-mail address; up to three administrators per school.

name: Grade Span
definition: Range of grades a school offers or serves, written in compact notation such as K-8 or 9-12.

name: School Enrollment
definition: Number of students enrolled at a school, reported separately for grades K-12 and for ages 5-17.

name: Free or Reduced Price Meal Count
definition: Count of students eligible for free or reduced price meals, reported for K-12 and for ages 5-17.

name: Eligible Free Rate
definition: Share of enrolled students eligible for free meals, derived as free meal count divided by enrollment.

name: NSLP Provision Status
definition: School meal provision category under the National School Lunch Program, including Multiple Provision Types, CEP and numbered provisions.

name: Magnet Program Indicator
definition: Flag stating whether a school offers a magnet program.

name: Virtual School Type
definition: Degree to which a school delivers instruction virtually; fully virtual schools are the exclusively virtual ones.

name: School and District Type Code
definition: Coded classification of a school or district such as Unified School District, Elementary School District, Intermediate/Middle Schools or High Schools.
scope: california_schools; DOC classifies districts, SOC classifies schools, EdOpsCode classifies educational operations

name: SAT Average Score
definition: Average SAT score of a school's test takers in reading, mathematics and writing.

name: Count of Test Takers Scoring 1500 or Above
definition: Number of SAT test takers at a school who scored at least 1500.

name: SAT Test Taker Count
definition: Number of students at a school who took the SAT.

name: Excellence Rate
definition: Proportion of SAT test takers at a school who scored 1500 or above, derived from the count above 1500 and the test taker count.

name: School Geographic Coordinates
definition: Latitude and longitude of a school in decimal degrees; all longitudes are negative because they lie west of the prime meridian.

name: School Open Date
definition: Date on which a school opened; used for school-age and opening-period questions.

name: Magic Card Printing
definition: A specific printing of a Magic: The Gathering card, uniquely identified by uuid, with attributes such as rarity, border colour, mana cost and artist.

name: Card Set
definition: A published expansion or set, identified by a short set code, English name, block, market name and MTGO code.

name: Set English Name
definition: Canonical English name of a card set.

name: Localized Set Name
definition: Set name translated into a specific language; the same set can be referenced by its localized name instead of its English name or code.

name: Foreign-Language Printing
definition: Language-specific version of a card carrying translated name, rules text, flavor text and type.

name: Card Language
definition: Language of a card printing or set translation.
scope: card_games; labels are exact strings such as Italian, French, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil)

name: Play Format
definition: Game format in which legality is assessed, such as commander, modern or gladiator; the format a card can be played under is also referred to as its rule.

name: Format Legality Status
definition: Legality of a card in a format: Legal, Banned or Restricted.

name: Card Ruling
definition: Official ruling text issued for a card on a given date.

name: Card Rarity
definition: Rarity of a card printing: common, uncommon, rare or mythic.

name: Card Border Colour
definition: Colour of the printed card border, such as black, white, gold, silver or borderless.

name: Converted Mana Cost
definition: Total mana cost of a card expressed as a single number.

name: EDHRec Rank
definition: Popularity rank of a card on EDHRec, where rank 1 is the most popular.

name: Content Warning Flag
definition: Flag marking whether a card printing has missing or degraded properties and values requiring a content warning.

name: Story Spotlight Flag
definition: Flag marking a card as part of a set's story spotlight cycle.

name: Card Power
definition: Power value printed on a creature card; absent cards have no power and some cards print an asterisk instead of a number.

name: Card Artist
definition: Illustrator credited for a card printing.

name: Energy Customer
definition: Customer of the energy retailer identified by CustomerID, with a business segment and a billing currency.

name: Customer Segment
definition: Business segment of a customer: KAM, LAM or SME.

name: Billing Currency
definition: Currency in which a customer pays for consumption: CZK or EUR.

name: Monthly Consumption
definition: Gas consumption recorded for one customer in one month.

name: Year-Month Period
definition: Six-character year and month key of a consumption record, where the first four characters are the year and the last two the month.

name: Consumption Change
definition: Difference and percentage change in consumption of a segment between two years.
scope: debit_card_specializing; percentage increase compares the yearly difference against the later year

name: Gas Station
definition: Fuel station identified by GasStationID, belonging to a chain and located in a country.

name: Gas Station Chain
definition: Chain number that groups gas stations under one operator.

name: Card Transaction
definition: Purchase transaction made at a gas station with a date, time, amount and price.

name: Product
definition: Product purchased in a transaction, identified by ProductID with a description.

name: Station Country
definition: Country where a gas station operates, coded CZE for the Czech Republic and SVK for Slovakia.

name: Bank Account
definition: Bank account opened in a district on a date with a statement issuance frequency.

name: Bank Client
definition: Person holding one or more bank accounts, with gender, birth date and home district.

name: Bank District
definition: Administrative district of a client or branch, described by coded attributes including name, region and average salary.

name: Account Client Disposition
definition: Link between a client and an account stating the client's disposition type (owner or user).

name: Loan
definition: Loan granted to an account with amount, duration, monthly payment and repayment status.

name: Account Transaction
definition: Debit or credit movement on an account with date, operation type, amount and balance.

name: Statement Issuance Frequency
definition: Coded frequency at which statements are issued for an account: weekly, monthly or after transaction.
scope: financial; values are Czech POPLATEK codes

name: Loan Repayment Status
definition: Coded repayment status of a loan, where code C marks a running contract that is still in order.

name: District Region
definition: Region of a district such as east Bohemia or north Bohemia, stored in lower case.

name: District Average Salary
definition: Average salary reported for a district.

name: Transaction Operation
definition: Specific operation performed in a transaction, such as cash withdrawal, card withdrawal, deposit or transfer.

name: Transaction Direction
definition: Whether a transaction is a debit (VYDAJ) or a credit (PRIJEM).

name: Formula 1 Driver
definition: Racing driver identified by driverId with reference name, code, forename, surname, date of birth and nationality.

name: Driver Full Name
definition: Full name of a driver formed by combining forename and surname.
scope: formula_1; used whenever a question names a driver in natural language

name: Racing Circuit
definition: Circuit on which races are held, with reference name, location, country, coordinates and altitude.

name: Formula 1 Constructor
definition: Team or constructor identified by constructorId with reference name, official name, nationality and website.

name: Formula 1 Race
definition: A Grand Prix event in a season at a circuit, identified by raceId and described by name and date.

name: Race Result
definition: One driver's result in one race, with grid position, finishing position, points, laps, race time and fastest lap.

name: Lap Time
definition: Time taken for a lap, recorded both as a formatted string and as milliseconds.

name: Qualifying Result
definition: A driver's qualifying performance in a race, with Q1, Q2 and Q3 segment times and resulting position.

name: Race Winner
definition: Driver classified first in a race, equivalently the champion of that race.
scope: formula_1 results; winner is the first classified position

name: Fastest Lap
definition: Quickest single lap in a race, identified by the minimum lap time and ranked within the race.

name: Race Completion
definition: Whether a driver finished a race, indicated by a recorded race time, and the resulting completion rate over a set of results.

name: Driver Age and Birth Year
definition: Age or birth year of a driver derived from the date of birth; oldest and youngest comparisons use this value.

name: Driver or Constructor Nationality
definition: Country of nationality recorded as a text label on drivers and constructors.
scope: formula_1; no country reference table exists

name: Student Club Member
definition: Member of the student club with name, position, t-shirt size, contact details and major.

name: Member Full Name
definition: Full name of a member formed from first name and last name.

name: Club Event
definition: Club event with a name, date-time, type, location, notes and status.

name: Event Attendance
definition: Record that a member attended a specific event.

name: Event Budget Line
definition: Budget line for an event and category, holding the budgeted amount, spent amount and remaining amount.

name: Club Expense
definition: Individual expense with a description, date, cost, approval flag, member and budget line.

name: Club Income
definition: Money received by the club on a date from a source such as dues, fundraising or sponsorship.

name: Academic Major
definition: Academic major with a name, department and college.

name: Department and College
definition: Organizational unit of a major, comprising an academic department within a college.

name: Event Status
definition: Lifecycle status of an event: Open, Closed or Planning.

name: Income Source
definition: Origin of club income such as Dues, Fundraising, Sponsorship or School Appropration.
scope: student_club income table; source labels are exact strings

name: Member Position
definition: Role held by a club member, distinguishing officers from ordinary members and inactive members.

name: Superhero
definition: Superhero character with name, full name, gender, colour attributes, race, publisher and physical measurements.

name: Superhero Full Name
definition: Real full name of a superhero; some heroes have no recorded full name.

name: Hero Attribute Value
definition: Numeric score of a superhero on one attribute such as strength, speed or intelligence.

name: Hero Attribute Type
definition: Name of a superhero attribute; the six attributes are Strength, Speed, Power, Intelligence, Durability and Combat.

name: Superpower
definition: Named superpower that can be assigned to one or more superheroes.

name: Comic Publisher
definition: Publisher that owns a superhero, such as Marvel Comics or DC Comics.

name: Eye Colour
definition: Eye colour of a superhero, drawn from the shared colour reference list.

name: Hair Colour
definition: Hair colour of a superhero, drawn from the shared colour reference list.

name: Skin Colour
definition: Skin colour of a superhero, drawn from the shared colour reference list.

name: Superhero Gender
definition: Gender of a superhero: Male, Female or N/A.

name: Superhero Race
definition: Species or race of a superhero such as Human, Mutant or God / Eternal; a dash marks unknown race.

name: Hero Height and Weight
definition: Height in centimetres and weight in kilograms of a superhero; a zero weight records an unrecorded weight.

name: Thrombosis Patient
definition: Patient under investigation, identified by ID with sex, birth date, admission type, first visit date and diagnosis.

name: Patient Age
definition: Age of a patient computed as the difference between the current year and the birth year.

name: Laboratory Test Record
definition: Set of laboratory measurements for one patient on one date, covering liver, metabolic, coagulation and immunological analytes.
scope: thrombosis_prediction Laboratory table; grain is patient and test date

name: Clinical Examination
definition: Examination record for a patient on a date capturing diagnosis, autoantibodies, coagulation measures, symptoms and thrombosis degree.

name: Disease Diagnosis
definition: Disease diagnosed for a patient or during an examination, coded as abbreviated disease names such as SLE, SJS, RA, BEHCET, PSS or MCTD.
scope: thrombosis_prediction; values can combine several diseases

name: Patient Sex
definition: Sex of a patient recorded as M or F.

name: Admission Type
definition: Whether a patient is an in-patient or an out-patient.

name: Coagulation Test Result
definition: Qualitative degree of coagulation from the KCT, RVVT and LAC tests, where a plus sign marks a positive measure.

name: Laboratory Analyte Measurement
definition: Numeric value of a named laboratory analyte such as GPT, ALB, GLU, T-CHO, CPK, CRE, PLT, IGG, IGM or UN.

name: Analyte Normal Range
definition: Reference interval defining when a laboratory analyte is within normal range, abnormal, or on the borderline.
scope: thrombosis_prediction; thresholds are stated per analyte

name: Patient Symptom Record
definition: Free-text symptom entry on an examination; a missing entry records that the patient has no symptom.

name: ANA Pattern
definition: Antinuclear antibody staining pattern recorded as combinations of S, P and D, where a single letter denotes a pattern of only that type.

name: Thrombosis Degree
definition: Numeric degree of thrombosis recorded for an examination.

name: Molecule
definition: Chemical molecule identified by molecule_id with a carcinogenicity label.

name: Carcinogenic Molecule
definition: Molecule labelled carcinogenic.

name: Non-Carcinogenic Molecule
definition: Molecule labelled non-carcinogenic.

name: Atom
definition: Atom within a molecule, identified by atom_id and carrying an element symbol.

name: Chemical Element
definition: Element of an atom recorded as a lower-case chemical symbol such as h, c, cl, br, i, s, p or f.

name: Chemical Bond
definition: Bond within a molecule, identified by bond_id with a bond type.

name: Bond Type
definition: Order of a chemical bond: single, double or triple.

name: Atom Connection
definition: Undirected connection between two atoms formed by a bond; each connection is stored twice, once per direction.

name: Element Ratio in Molecule
definition: Share of atoms of a given element among all atoms of a molecule.
